column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:struct module
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# Loadable module of voxgig-struct data-manipulation utilities. These
# words were moved out of the core registry; they are reached only after
# `import`, under the `Struct` namespace: `"aql:struct-util" import end
# StructUtil.word args`.
# §1  merge — deep, index-wise merge (later argument wins)
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.merge {a:1 b:2} {b:3 c:4}
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.merge {a:{x:1 y:2}} {a:{y:3 z:4}}
# §2  getpath — read a dotted path
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.getpath "a.b" {a:{b:42}}
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.getpath "name" {name:'Alice'}
# §3  setpath — write at a path (returns a new structure)
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.setpath {a:1} "b" 99
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.setpath {a:{b:1} c:2} "a.b" 99
column3: nested set keeps the outer wrapper + siblings

column1: aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.setpath {a:1} "x.y" 5
column3: a nested path creates intermediate maps

column1: aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.setpath {xs:[10 20 30]} "xs.1" 9
column3: a numeric segment indexes a list

column1: # §4  clone — deep copy (forward or stack form)
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.clone {a:1 b:2}
aql:struct-util import end {a:1 b:2} StructUtil.clone
# §5  items — map entries as [key value] pairs
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.items {a:1 b:2}
# §6  validate — check data against a shape spec (returns the validated spec)
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.validate {name:"$STRING"} {name:'Alice'}
column3: conforming data validates against the spec

column1: # §7  transform — shape data via a spec (forward: spec then data)
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.transform {x:99} {a:'1'}
# §8  jsonify — serialise a value (also moved here; output verified in the
#     Go tests, the pretty-printed multiline form isn't tsv-expressible)
# §8b  nodify — project a value to its Node/Scalar form (pass-through when no
#      projection behavior is registered for the type)
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.nodify {a:1 b:2}
# §9  swap form dispatches through the namespace
aql:struct-util import end {a:1} StructUtil.merge {b:2}
# §10  negative — unbound without import
StructUtil.merge {a:1} {b:2}
jsonify {a:1}
column3: jsonify also moved out of core

column1: # §11  inject — resolve backtick `$`-path references against a store
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.inject {greeting:'`name`'} {name:'Alice'}
# §12  selector — query-select children matching a spec
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.selector {color:'red'} {a:{color:'red'} b:{color:'blue'}}
# §13  walk — collect leaf path/value pairs
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.walk {a:1 b:{c:2}}
# §14  jsonify — serialise a value. Scalars render on one line (the
#      pretty-printed multiline form for maps/lists isn't tsv-expressible —
#      see §8 — so the Map output is verified in the Go tests).
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.jsonify 42
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.jsonify 'hi'
aql:struct-util import end StructUtil.jsonify true
# §  reify — hydrate a class instance from JSON text or a Node; the
#    inverse of the instance-aware jsonify. Explicit class target (with
#    $class cross-check) or tor-union target ($class selects the
#    member, bounded to the union). Hydration routes through make:
#    defaults fill, required fields enforced, predicates run, unknown
#    keys error. jsonify carries $class on class instances and escapes
#    user $-keys to $$ (spoof-proof round-trip).
aql:struct-util import end  def Point class {x:1, y:2} def p (StructUtil.reify Point {x:9}) p typeof
column3: reify from a Node constructs a typed instance

column1: aql:struct-util import end  def Point class {x:1, y:2} (StructUtil.reify Point {x:9}) get y
aql:struct-util import end  def Point class {x:1} (StructUtil.reify Point (StructUtil.jsonify (make Point {x:9}))) get x
column3: full jsonify→reify round trip through JSON text

column1: aql:struct-util import end  def Circle class {r:1.0} def Square class {side:1.0} def Shape (Circle tor Square) (StructUtil.reify Shape (StructUtil.jsonify (make Square {side:4.0}))) typeof
aql:struct-util import end  def Circle class {r:1.0} def Square class {side:1.0} def Shape (Circle tor Square) StructUtil.reify Shape {r:2.0}
column3: a union target without $class is a loud error

column1: aql:struct-util import end  def Point class {x:1} StructUtil.reify Point {z:5}
column3: an undeclared key errors (hydration is sealed construction)

column1: aql:struct-util import end  def Radius (Float gte 0.0) def Circle class {r:Radius} StructUtil.reify Circle '{"r": -1.5}'
column3: predicate field types run during hydration

column1: aql:struct-util import end  def Radius (Float gte 0.0) def Circle class {r:Radius} (StructUtil.reify Circle '{"r": 5}') get r
column3: schema-driven recovery: a JSON integer lands as the Float the field declares

column1: aql:struct-util import end  StructUtil.reify Integer {x:1}
